notes.title: Welcome to Note Buddy
notes.body:
# Welcome to Note Buddy

Note Buddy is a lightweight **Markdown** note-taking app. Everything is saved locally in your browser.

## Features

- Write in Markdown with a live *preview*
- Use the toolbar or shortcuts like `Ctrl+B` for bold
- Link notes together with `[[` autocomplete
- Export your notes as JSON any time

> Try switching to Preview mode with the button in the top right.

Check out [Project Ideas](#note-sample-note-ideas) for an example of a note link.

notes.title: Recipe Box
notes.body:
# Recipe Box

## Simple Pasta

- 200g pasta
- 2 cloves garlic
- Olive oil
- Chili flakes

```
Boil pasta, saute garlic in oil, toss together, add chili flakes.
```

> Add parmesan to taste.
